Add a package dependency, model, external service, secret, account, download, or externally controlled asset

retained_failures: The first independent-validator run compared the frozen evidence-kind list to a sorted set, reversing the intended telemetry/status presentation order and reporting a false mismatch; the validator now checks both the exact declared order and exact set without changing any scenario, expectation, or candidate rule.

units.purpose: Implement and test one generic stale metadata-projection candidate plus separate boundary-exposure metrics and gates
retained_failures: The first attempt to preserve the pre-change manifest by recreating its JSON through apply_patch changed only Windows line endings and produced a different SHA-256; it was superseded by an exact byte copy that matches f02a330566834ae1d28139761ec7728c4f8fb4bb7b44b0dfd7aace80f53259ec.

The first complete-suite candidate run found that the optional model adapter required document content with direct indexing and raised KeyError on metadata-only stale evidence before any model call; the generic serializer now preserves only fields actually present, and a focused model-boundary regression asserts that stale title and content are absent.

The same complete-suite run found one stale test expectation for manifest checkpoint baseline-0009 after the candidate manifest was correctly sealed as baseline-0010; the expectation was corrected without changing a scenario, candidate, metric, or grader.

units.purpose: Reveal held-out results once, run repeated evaluation, compare v2 and candidate evidence, and select only a measured Pareto improvement

Version, validate real CLI, API, MCP, approval, executor, dashboard, persistence, telemetry, container, and package surfaces; reconcile records; clean-clone; review; merge; tag; release; and verify the bounded checkpoint
retained_failures: The first combined final-gate command passed evaluation and tests, then failed on a missing standalone PYTHONPATH and a guessed milestone-validator filename; the corrected bounded rerun passed without changing source or frozen evidence.

Docker was off at release time and a non-gating wheel probe found no local setuptools.build_meta; container packaging remains deferred by the existing source gate and no package-registry claim is made.
GitHub temporarily reported mergeability UNKNOWN after the receipt-only push; it returned to CLEAN and MERGEABLE before promotion and merge.
The dashboard renderer emitted a post-write task-manager warning and the image viewer intermittently showed only a lower strip; independent checks and reopened full images passed.
